title: 28 Countries, 14 Survive 🔥 Brazil vs Germany vs Egypt | Country Marble Race Heat 1/7
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 2, Round 1 · Heat 1/7: 28 countries race through 3 stages — only 14 survive and go to Round 2.

Countries in this heat: Algeria, Bahrain, Belarus, Bhutan, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Burundi, Chile, Comoros, Costa Rica, Egypt, El Salvador, Equatorial Guinea, Germany, Ghana, Honduras, Jordan, Latvia, Malawi, Mauritania, Micronesia, Netherlands, Nigeria, Palau, Rwanda, Saudi Arabia, Solomon Islands, United Arab Emirates.

Countries still in the game before this race: 193 of 193.
Next race: Round 1 · Heat 2/7. Grand Final: Nov 12.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. New races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
